summary: Nexxen International filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its September 29, 2026 Annual General Meeting. Holders of 24,004,886 ordinary shares were present and entitled to vote out of 56,950,169 outstanding at the August 24, 2026 record date. Shareholders re-elected five directors, approved auditor appointment and compensation, and approved equity incentive plans. Proposal No. 4 was withdrawn by the Board before the meeting after investor feedback, with a revised proposal to be presented at a later shareholder meeting. A footnote notes Mithaq Capital SPC could not exercise voting rights above 25% under Israeli Companies Law Section 333(b). No special-situation transaction terms disclosed.
